objective: Establish and prove one perfect Smart Board reference before any replication to the remaining Smart Notes.
long_term_objective: After the reference is independently proven, replicate the proven structure to the remaining canonical Smart Notes without architectural drift.
allowed_scope: current Smart Board semantic labels, icons, geometry and border treatment
removal of explicitly forbidden Smart Board UI
current sidebar destination set, order, semantic keys and hover colors
removal of Smart Mail New badge/item while preserving Smart Mail
runtime acceptance tests required to prove the one-board reference

reference_board.title: What Is Naya Power?
labels: HOW TO USE / HOW TO APPLY
reference_board.layout: one full-width board, nine sections vertically stacked; no two-column or tiled board layout
reference_board.how_to_apply_position: immediately above What's In It For You

forbidden_ui: What, Human, Simple/Simplified, Why/Notice, Naya, Learning, So What, For You
content_policy: Do not rewrite, summarize, invent, or truncate Smart Note content. The renderer may relocate existing canonical source text into the approved visual structure only.
deployment_policy: Only the canonical governed 509 world-class runtime workflow may deploy the GitHub 509 lane. The Assistant Cloudflare/live Hub lane remains separate and is not claimed or substituted by this contract.
replication_policy: Do not replicate until the one-board reference passes all candidate and post-deploy acceptance gates. Once proven, replicate the exact proven structure surgically to the remaining canonical Smart Notes.
release_rule: No public deployment is permitted unless governance authorization, execution contract, candidate build/static acceptance, candidate browser acceptance, and post-deploy browser acceptance all pass for the reference board.
success_definition: One reference board is visually correct, structurally correct, content-correct, sidebar-correct, responsive, and independently proven at candidate and public runtime; a cold Naya can identify the exact next replication action without conversational archaeology.
